title: Cool stuff near Wink Saigon
sub: Hipster cafés and wanders on foot from Wink Hotel Saigon Centre (Đa Kao), Nov 2026
tip: Every spot shows its walk time from Wink and the Directions button routes from the hotel. Đa Kao and Tân Định are the low-rise, local side of District 1. For the bigger hipster scene (Tôn Thất Đạm, Café Apartment), Grab it ~10 min south, see the Hipster areas tab.
area: District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

places.name: A Coffee House

notes: Free; go early morning before the tour groups

notes: Hidden down an alley, done up like grandma's old Saigon house

places.name: Tân Định Church
notes: The pink church, then the low-rise lanes behind it (Time Out's 12th coolest neighbourhood, 2026)
